subject.title: fix(agents): stop tool discovery from breaking prompt caches

question: Should existing Tool Search directory-mode users intentionally move from prompt-selected directly visible schemas to a fully deferred directory surface except for policy-required direct tools?
rationale: The cache-stability goal is supported by the patch and proof, but the PR changes a documented, user-observable behavior for existing opted-in configurations. The supplied PR rationale asserts prior approval, while the protected labels require the responsible maintainer to confirm that this compatibility tradeoff is intended.

options.title: Preserve directory compatibility
options.body: Keep a deterministic, policy-owned direct-tool compatibility surface so existing directory-mode users retain direct invocation behavior without prompt-order cache churn.

options.title: Adopt the deferred directory contract
options.body: Explicitly confirm that existing directory-mode users should use search and describe for previously prompt-selected schemas, accepting the documented upgrade behavior.

options.title: Split the CI repair
options.body: Land or review the checksum-pinned OpenGrep installer separately so the agent compatibility decision remains narrowly reviewable.
